page_title: TOU 0-0 AUX | Toulouse v Auxerre 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' This is a yellow card! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
87' Pape Demba (Toulouse) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon was alert and made a comfortable save.
87' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Danny Namaso (Auxerre) and he is replaced by Sekou Mara.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Assane Diousse is coming onto the pitch as Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Today's match ends for Gideon Mensah who will be replaced by Bryan Okoh (Auxerre).
85' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
82' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
82' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Elisha Owusu.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
77' A goal, which was scored by Danny Namaso (Auxerre), was disallowed due to offside.
76' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
76' A cross from a corner kick by Toulouse is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
74' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
74' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Noah Edjouma replaces Emersonn (Toulouse).
73' That will be all from Djibril Sidibe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
73' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josue Casimir (Auxerre) replacing Romain Faivre.
71' The total number of attempts is 9:7.
69' Pape Demba (Toulouse) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call.
67' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle and it's Romain Faivre (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
61' The ball is cleared after Danny Namaso (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Dangerous play by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
55' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
53' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle. Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) commits a foul after dangerous play.
51' Pape Demba (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
49' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) was too forceful with his tackle and Romain Lissorgue interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' The resulting corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is cleared.
48' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Donovan Leon. The referee signals a corner kick to Toulouse.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
42' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for an infringement.
40' Celebrations are cut short for Toulouse as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
39' Wait! Referee Romain Lissorgue has indicated he is going to review the Toulouse goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

38' Goal! Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) latches on to a superb pass inside the box, finds himself in a promising position and fires a shot in off the crossbar. The goalkeeper was helpless to keep out his effort.
37' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
36' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Danny Namaso (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
32' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Romain Lissorgue saw the whole situation.
31' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.

30' That didn't go as planned. Yann Gboho (Toulouse) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Donovan Leon, who easily kept it out.
26' Crossbar! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
25' The corner is swung in but Auxerre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' What a sweet touch by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Guillaume Restes to hold. Auxerre earn a corner.
23' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
21' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Toulouse was in an offside position.
21' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
19' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Emersonn (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' Pape Demba (Toulouse) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon is alert and makes a decent save.
14' Romain Faivre (Auxerre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

14' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Auxerre.

12' Romain Faivre (Auxerre) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Romain Lissorgue with no other option than to blow for a foul.
10' The referee blows his whistle as Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) was too aggressive in his challenge.
9' Auxerre take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
9' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Donovan Leon.
8' Neat passing move from Toulouse in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Danny Namaso (Auxerre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' The Auxerre players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Auxerre will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
